title: SegFix: Model-Agnostic Boundary Refinement for Segmentation
mechanism: Predict a boundary map and a direction map; replace each boundary pixel's label with that of an interior pixel along the predicted direction; applies to predictions or labels.
adaptation: Post-processing and label cleaning for blob/band classes (inactive, ribbons, border, frame_edge, edge_dark); not for 1 to 2 px cracks (no interior).
min_experiment: Arm: SegFix head trained once, applied to house predictions; baseline: house. Metric: mIoU_rob, inactive IoU. Kill if mIoU_rob gain < 0.01.
evidence: R: boundary quality gains on Cityscapes/ADE20K (known from paper; numbers not read here).
